shortcutMenu.title: Shortcut Menu
shortcutMenu.description: Choose which items appear as shortcuts in the sidebar. Unselected items remain in the menu popup.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Tell this lobster the rules you care about most. It should keep these reminders in mind during future actions, so you do not need to repeat them every time.

compose.title: Add reminder
compose.description: Write your rules one by one, like a simple checklist.
compose.helper: Short and direct reminders work best.
compose.label: Reminder text
compose.placeholder: For example: Do not delete or forward emails, do not send files to anyone, and do not expose personal information without my approval.

presets.title: Quick presets
presets.description: Start with a few common rules, then adjust them to match your needs.
presets.privacy: Do not expose my personal or private information to anyone else.
presets.files: Do not send my files to other people without my approval.
presets.mail: Do not send, forward, or delete emails unless I confirm first.
presets.approval: Ask me before making payments, deleting things, sending things out, or making bulk changes.
presets.externalShare: Do not share contacts, accounts, attachments, or chat content with outside people.

list.title: Current reminders
list.description: Each reminder can be turned on, paused, edited, or removed.
list.empty: No reminders yet. Start with a preset on the left or write your own.

toasts.exists: That reminder is already in the list
toasts.interrupted: Current run stopped so updated reminders can take effect immediately.

aiProviders.title: AI Providers
aiProviders.description: Configure your AI model providers and API keys

overview.title: Provider Accounts
overview.description: A summary of the provider accounts and models currently configured.

localModelDialog.title: Add Local Model
localModelDialog.desc: Add a local model entry. Enter the model name, API key, service URL, and protocol, and the app will sync it into OpenClaw.
localModelDialog.displayNameHelp: Used in the list and default-model summary. Enter a clear model name manually.
localModelDialog.serviceUrlHelp: Enter the endpoint URL for this model service, such as a private deployment or internal gateway `/v1` URL.

empty.title: No providers configured
empty.desc: Add an AI provider to start using ClawClaw

dialog.title: Add AI Provider
dialog.desc: Configure a new AI model provider
dialog.authMethodOauthHint: Use the provider login flow and import the available models after authorization.
dialog.authMethodApiKeyHint: Use an API key and optional model override for direct provider access.
dialog.apiKeyConfigured: An API key is already stored for this provider.
dialog.apiKeyMissing: No API key is stored for this provider yet.
dialog.apiKeyStored: Your API key is stored locally on your machine.
dialog.replaceApiKeyHelp: Leave this field empty if you want to keep the currently stored API key.
dialog.allowPrivateNetworkHelp: Allow this self-hosted provider to reach localhost, RFC1918, and other private network endpoints through OpenClaw.
dialog.verifiedModelsHelp: Prefer selecting a real model returned by this source to avoid saving an invalid model ID.
dialog.noFilteredModels: No models match the current filters
dialog.noVerifiedModels: No verified model list is available yet. You can still enter a model ID manually.
dialog.fallbackModelIdsHelp: One model ID per line. These models use the current provider config before falling back to other providers.
dialog.noFallbackOptions: Add another provider first to use it as a fallback target.

toast.modelMustMatchVerified: Select a model from the verified list for this source
toast.minimaxConflict: Cannot add both MiniMax (Global) and MiniMax (CN) providers.

oauth.loginPrompt: This provider requires signing in via your browser.
oauth.loginCompleted: Browser sign-in is complete. Choose the model to use next.
oauth.browserFlowUnavailable: Browser OAuth is not wired for this provider yet.
oauth.browserApproveDesc: OpenClaw has launched the native OpenAI Codex sign-in page. Complete the authorization in your browser.
oauth.browserApproveHint: If the browser did not open automatically, use the button below to reopen the authorization page.
oauth.authSucceeded: Sign-in completed. Choose the model to use next.
oauth.modelAfterLogin: After sign-in, choose from the Codex models currently available in OpenClaw.
oauth.manualPrompt: If the browser asks for another input, enter it here.
oauth.manualPlaceholder: Enter the value requested by the browser
oauth.step2: Open the login page in your browser.
oauth.step3: Paste the code to approve access.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyModeSystemHelp: Use your system proxy settings. Best when your proxy is already configured at the OS or proxy-app level.
gateway.proxyModeCustomHelp: Explicitly configure proxy addresses and advanced overrides for ClawClaw and the Gateway.
gateway.proxyModeDirectHelp: Do not use any proxy. All requests connect directly to upstream services.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Configure session archival and cross-session memory recall.
memory.sessionMemoryDesc: When enabled, finished conversations are automatically saved when you reset or start a new chat, so they can be referenced later.
memory.searchDesc: When enabled, later chats can recall previously saved notes and conversation memories. Changing this restarts the Gateway automatically.
memory.localModelLeanDesc: Enable OpenClaw's lightweight local-model execution mode. Useful when you want local providers to prefer lower-overhead runtime behavior. Changing this restarts the Gateway automatically.

updates.title: Updates
updates.channelFixedDesc: Only the stable release channel is available right now. The app always checks the stable feed.
updates.unsupported: Automatic updates are not available in the current environment. Install a packaged build to use them.

status.check: Check for updates to get the latest features

updates.channelDesc: Only the stable update feed is currently available.
updates.help: When auto-update is enabled, updates are downloaded and installed automatically.

advanced.title: Advanced

transport.label: Gateway Transport Preference
transport.desc: Choose how renderer requests gateway RPC: WebSocket, HTTP proxy, or IPC fallback.

advanced.slashCommandHintsDesc: Show the slash command suggestion menu when typing / in the chat composer

security.title: Security Policy
security.enableDirectoryPolicyDesc: Turn this on to apply the limits below right away. Turn it off to keep the settings without actively blocking actions.

explainer.policyScope: Denied directories are a simple 'do not touch this area' rule. ClawClaw writes them into the workspace instructions so the assistant stays away.
explainer.runtimeScope: Behavior restrictions are the actual blockers. Turn one on and that action is stopped directly.

rules.title: Preset restrictions
rules.description: Each switch controls one thing the assistant is allowed to do. Turn it on to stop that action.

denyRuntime.label: Block runtime commands
denyRuntime.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer run commands or start programs.

denyWrite.label: Block file writes
denyWrite.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer create, edit, or overwrite files.

denyRead.label: Block file reads
denyRead.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer directly read local files.

denyBrowser.label: Block browser automation
denyBrowser.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer open pages, click buttons, fill forms, or control the browser.

denyWebSearch.label: Block web search
denyWebSearch.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer search the web for information.

denyWebFetch.label: Block web fetch
denyWebFetch.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer read page content directly from websites.

denyGateway.label: Block gateway access
denyGateway.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer use the local connection channel.

security.pendingNotice: These changes are not active yet. Apply them to sync the config and restart the Gateway.

summary.enabled: {{rules}} restrictions enabled and {{count}} denied directories configured.

sections.directoriesDesc: List the folders the assistant should stay away from. They are saved as clear do-not-touch areas in the workspace instructions.
sections.behaviorDesc: Each switch below controls one capability. Turn it on to block that action directly.

runtimePreview.title: Actions that will be blocked
runtimePreview.inSync: The runtime restrictions are in sync with the saved settings.
runtimePreview.extraRestrictions: The restrictions managed by this page are in sync, but the runtime still has extra deny rules.
runtimePreview.outOfSync: The runtime restrictions differ from the settings saved in this page and may have been changed externally.
runtimePreview.unsaved: There are unapplied changes. Apply them to sync the runtime config and restart the Gateway.
runtimePreview.none: No blocked actions are selected right now.

toasts.enablePromptPolicyFirst: Please add at least one denied directory or enable at least one preset restriction before enabling security policy.
toasts.interrupted: Current run stopped so the updated security policy can take effect immediately.

security.loadingDescription: Syncing the current security policy. Please wait.

developer.title: Developer
developer.consoleDesc: Access the native OpenClaw management interface
developer.consoleNote: Opens the Control UI with gateway token injected
developer.gatewayTokenDesc: Paste this into Control UI settings if prompted
developer.cliDesc: Copy a command to run OpenClaw without modifying PATH.
developer.wsDiagnosticDesc: Temporarily enable WS/HTTP fallback chain for gateway RPC debugging.
developer.doctorDesc: Run OpenClaw diagnose or auto-fix against the bundled runtime and current config.
developer.doctorFixSucceededWithWarnings: OpenClaw doctor fix completed with warnings
developer.doctorFixFailed: OpenClaw doctor fix did not complete successfully
developer.installDetail: This will create ~/.local/bin/openclaw. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH if you want to run it globally.

dataTools.title: Data & Uninstall
dataTools.description: Export a backup first, then clean local data from a fixed allowlist before uninstalling.

export.title: Export config
export.description: Export the current settings as a JSON backup before cleanup or system uninstall. Portable builds default to portable/exports/settings.

cleanup.title: Clean up data
cleanup.description: Gateway will be stopped first, and only managed directories are deleted.
cleanup.runtimeNotice: On Windows, ClawClaw settings, cache, and logs continue cleaning after the app exits so file locks do not block deletion.
cleanup.removeClawClawDataDesc: Clears local settings, window state, and cached application data.
cleanup.removeOpenClawDataDesc: Deletes sessions, skills, provider config, and other data under the managed OpenClaw data directory.
cleanup.removeWorkspaceDesc: Only deletes managed OpenClaw workspace directories and never touches external custom folders.
cleanup.removeGatewayServiceDesc: Attempts to run openclaw gateway uninstall to remove the system gateway service or task.
cleanup.confirmMessage: This will stop the Gateway and delete the selected local data. Export a backup first. This action cannot be undone.
cleanup.nothingSelected: Select at least one cleanup scope
cleanup.quitRequired: Exit cleanup has been queued. ClawClaw will quit shortly to finish the remaining deletion.
cleanup.noResult: No cleanup has been run yet.

fullUninstall.title: Full uninstall prep
fullUninstall.description: Run the heaviest cleanup first, then remove the ClawClaw app from the system uninstaller.
fullUninstall.warning: Export a backup first. This stops the Gateway, uninstalls the Gateway service, and removes ClawClaw local data, logs, OpenClaw data, and managed workspaces.
fullUninstall.confirmMessage: This performs the heaviest cleanup and prepares the machine for uninstall. The app binary still needs to be removed from the OS uninstaller. Continue?
fullUninstall.success: Full cleanup finished. Remove ClawClaw from the OS uninstaller next.
fullUninstall.after: After this step, remove the ClawClaw application from your system's uninstall entry.

gatewayPorts.title: Gateway Ports
gatewayPorts.description: Detect and manage all OpenClaw Gateway instances running on this machine.
gatewayPorts.noGateways: No gateways detected. Click Scan to search ports 18789–18799.
gatewayPorts.confirmKillMessage: Stop the gateway running on port {{port}}? The other ClawClaw instance will need to restart its gateway manually. This cannot be undone.

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.description: Backup and restore your ClawClaw settings and configuration.

backupRestore.exportHelp: Save all settings, OpenClaw config, and provider list to a JSON file. API keys are stored in your system keychain and are not exported.
backupRestore.importHelp: Restore settings from a previously exported backup file.
backupRestore.confirmMessage: This will import settings from a backup created with ClawClaw {{version}} on {{date}}, including {{providers}} configured provider(s). The current settings will be overwritten. An auto-backup of your current state will be created first.
backupRestore.confirmGeneric: This will overwrite your current settings with the imported backup.
